title: PCSO GM Mel Robles gets PCG Auxiliary Merit Medal
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) General Manager Melquiades “Mel” A. Robles received on Thursday the Philippine Coast Guard Auxiliary (PCGA) Merit Medal and Ribbon…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) General Manager Melquiades “Mel” A. Robles received on Thursday the Philippine Coast Guard Auxiliary (PCGA) Merit Medal and Ribbon during a ceremony at PCG the headquarters in Manila. The award recognized his volunteerism, compassion, and commitment to public service. Robles, an auxiliary commodore in the PCGA, was cited for his contributions in advancing the welfare of PCG personnel and continued service to the public.
